# blackboard-coordinator

> Coordinate agents through a shared blackboard: versioned JSON entries, knowledge sources triggered by key changes, deterministic priority scheduling, fault isolation and a goal check. Python package `trysac-blackboard-coordinator`, import name `blackboard_coordinator`, MIT licensed, Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): problem, install, usage example, public API summary, errors and limits
- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): components, scheduling algorithm, error handling, limits
- [Security](docs/SECURITY.md): threat model, input validation, data integrity, logging, determinism
- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): how to run and what the tests cover
- [Project](docs/PROJECT.md): objective, scope and out-of-scope
